comments.author: @GeorgePetrou-vz4gy
comments.text:
Cyprus is the ugliest island in the Mediterranean! Its cities lack proper urban planning, infrastructure leaves a lot to be desired, and urban noise pollution is high. 
Lots of concrete with very little green.
It is the most corrupt EU country with an incompetent judiciary. If you are rich or know "the right people", you can literally get away with murder.
The government is hostile towards the average citizen.
The Civil Service is an intimidating, highly bureaucratic apparatus, staffed by well paid, lazy and grumpy public employees.
As with Iran, Cypus is a theocratic democracy, where the clergy co-governs with the elected president and House of Representatives. The church still bans cremation so it can sell its cementery plots at exorbidant prices. It even has a say on who is appointed a minister. 
Since 1963 it has the most anachronistic constitution in the whole of Europe.
Art, although sparse and subpar, is considerably overpriced.
Cypriots have bad manners. They rarely say "please" and "thank you" and are aggressive, overstressed and generally not very trustworthy.
The list of negatives would be very long...
The positives: mild winters (summers are extremely hot) and some nice beaches.
